newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon wins $262 mln turnkey contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon wins $262 mln turnkey contract.

text.p: Raytheon Engineers & Constructors said Monday a consortium it is leading has been awarded a $262 million turnkey contract to provide engineering, procurement, and construction services for a grassroots hot briquetted iron production facility in Guayana City, Venezuela.
In addition to Raytheon, the consortium consists of POSCO Engineering & Construction Co Ltd., a subsidiary of the Pohang Iron & Steel Co of Korea, Raytheon said.
Raytheon said it will be responsible for 70 percent of the work and receive about $190 million.
Raytheon said the new facility will be designed to produce 1.5 million metric tons per year of a briquetted form of direct reduced iron, which is used in making steel.
Raytheon Engineers & Constructors is a unit of Raytheon Co.
